args.body: Hi Dora! Thanks for inviting me to take a look at your website (www.dora-website.com). Here's my feedback: it's clean and to the point — visitors instantly know it's your personal site, and having your email (dora@gmail.com) right on the page makes it very easy to get in touch. My one suggestion: it's quite minimal, so consider adding a little more about yourself — a short bio, what you do, or your interests — so first-time visitors get a fuller picture of who you are. Overall, simple and effective!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that it's clearly identified as your blog, and the personal touch of sharing your favorite hobby — hiking — makes it feel warm and approachable. My suggestion: it's fairly sparse right now, so it would be great to see actual blog posts, a bit more about why you love hiking, and maybe some trail photos or links to your recent posts.
